title: Gameing Hall 品牌徽记
intendedUse: 大厅页眉、登录/恢复页和加载状态使用的独立图形徽记；品牌文字由 H5 绘制
prompt: Create an original transparent-background emblem for a friendly premium casual game platform. Combine a simple rounded arch or doorway silhouette with one ivory game-card shape and a restrained warm-gold glint, using the supplied reference's polished dimensional teal/ivory/gold finish. Keep the emblem geometric, balanced and recognizable at 48 px, without copying its exact card fan or medallion. Leave generous transparent padding; no wordmark because interface text is rendered separately.
negativePrompt: letters, words, Chinese characters, numbers, copied playing-card fan, copied medallion, real brand marks, photorealism, flat vector, watermark, signature

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Palette, dimensional finish, soft lighting and bevel style only.
